name: delete the triangles whose circumcircle contains the new point and refill the hole from it
mechanism: start with a super-triangle; insert points one at a time: remove every triangle whose circumscribed circle contains the new point (they form a connected hole), and connect the new point to every edge of the hole boundary; the empty-circle property is restored after each insertion

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bowyer–Watson algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry: create voronoi diagram in any number of dimensions

requires: a locating step for the containing triangle
fails_when: four co-circular points are ambiguous; worst case quadratic
